content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working on setting up SMS alerts for a remote [product_name] device using a [product_name] module. Additionally, I’d like to enable monitoring through an Amazon IoT cloud instance, a feature offered in the new [product_name] and [product_name] versions, to allow remote access via the cloud. Cloud integration is a nice bonus, but the SMS functionality via [product_name] is essential for my setup. While checking the [product_name] documentation, I found a section that raised concerns. Does this mean it’s not possible to operate both the SMS module and the cloud monitoring at the same time on the [product_name] device? If so, what’s the reason? Or is the documentation simply stating that changes via [product_name] tools (like website updates) are not allowed when the SMS module is active, but previously configured sites remain accessible and operational? Is there a difference if both the SMS module and the cloud solution are only accessing (reading) the [product_name] device data, without modifying any variables? I would appreciate any clarification on this matter!

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to combine SMS notifications using the [product_name] module with remote cloud monitoring through Amazon IoT, involving [product_name] hardware and software. The main concern is whether both functionalities can be active at the same time, as the wording in the documentation is unclear. Clarity is needed on compatibility and system limits, particularly if both functions only read data and not write to the controller.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks to enable both SMS alerts and cloud-based remote monitoring together on a single [product_name] controller, preferably without feature conflicts, especially in data read-only scenarios. Users expect official resources to clearly address this type of setup.
